deadline.value: Doctoral applications at the University of Bern are accepted throughout the year once a thesis supervisor agrees (fall semester registration runs September 1 to October 15).
deadline.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No Physics GRE requirement is stated on the physics doctorate page.

supervisor.value: A confirmation of supervision must be filled in before admission; the physics page also tells candidates to approach a research group leader directly.
supervisor.quote: Fill in the confirmation of supervision that applies to your doctorate.

also.quote: Interessenten melden sich direkt bei einem Leiter einer Forschungsgruppe, um die Möglichkeit eines Doktorats abzuklären

funding.value: The physics page gives no funding rule for admitted doctoral students.

entry_route.value: A master's degree or licentiate from a Swiss university, or an equivalent degree, is needed for doctoral admission.
entry_route.quote: For admission at doctoral level, you must | hold a master's degree or a licentiate from a Swiss university or Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, or an equivalent university degree

notes: Astronomy is listed as also_fields because the physics doctorate page says supervisors come from the Physics and Astronomy institutes (quoted under supervisor). The page is German; quotes are verbatim German. The Studienplan PDF is not used. Re-checked 2026-10-29: the physics page sends applicants to the central dates page and states no English or IELTS rule, so ielts_min stays with the university record.
